wikitext: :[Ponytail, standing at a whiteboard containing illegible text and arrows, is considering a logical proof with a hand on her chin. The proof assumes ''P'' and deduces ''P'' ∧ ''P'', which is written on the bottom of the whiteboard.] :Ponytail: Wow. I can't find fault with your proof. :[Ponytail is still looking at the white board, the frame expands to show Megan walking away, rubbing her hands together.] :Ponytail: You've shown the inconsistency — and thus the invalidity — of basic logic itself. :Megan: Excellent. On to step two... :[Megan sits down at a desk and begins to write.] :Written text: Dear Dr. Knuth, :[She continues to write.] :Written text: I am writing to collect from you the $3,372,564.48 I am owed for discovering 1,317,408 errors in ''The Art of Computer Programming...''
